report:
Executed on the lab workspace (ci-runner) against `repo-deep-dive @ 48e6c44`:

- `git fetch --prune origin && git reset --hard origin/main` -> `48e6c44`.
- `python3 tools/deterministic_checks.py . --deep -o /tmp/det-rdd2 --run repo-deep-dive` -> 2 findings (P2 x1, P3 x1); areas DET.

The lab has gitleaks 8.x installed (no hit under the reviewed `.gitleaks.toml`); actionlint, hadolint, shellcheck, trivy and zizmor are not installed on the lab, so those machine checks were skipped and are recorded as findings rather than assumed pass.
